author: Atlas
limitations: This evidence-backed candidate removes per-order SQLite/Python result handoffs in the capacity inventory while preserving all original rows and validation. Controlled SQL improved; a bounded whole-publication experiment did not establish overall latency improvement.

The original live capacity-publication phase includes lease renewal and transaction admission, so its exact delay cause remains unknown. Historical post-capture cold header validation is a separate cost.

Local installation does not establish loading or sustained runtime recovery in an existing manually started worker. Unknown original submissions retain their commitments without guessed IDs, release or resend.
runtime_implications: Only exact reviewed authority and test changes installed, retaining local LF source formatting and unrelated bytes. No trader start/restart, control, broker/provider/order/replay, schedule, binding, model, or trading-state changes. Future manual launch and naturally exercised affected behavior remain separate stages.
scope: Shared source correctness and read efficiency for each PC independently; local model recipes, scientific probabilities, direction policies and execution state retained
summary: Atlas 15m capacity inventory candidate published and locally installed
tests: 44 fresh offline checks passed on reviewed, immutable queued, source and common-main candidates. 180 installed offline checks passed with exact local imports and unchanged tested bytes. Old per-row behavior, REAL precision and nondefault text-factory regressions reproduced before their corrections.
